calls.function: claim(address recipient_, uint256 cumulativeAmount_, uint8 positionType_, bytes32 positionId_, uint256 cycle_, bytes32[] merkleProof_, bytes metadata_)

cumulativeAmount_.free: part of the Merkle leaf: the distributor reverts unless the proof hashes it into the published root; the effects require the Safe to get a positive amount of the card's token and nothing else

positionType_.free: part of the Merkle leaf, checked against the root like cumulativeAmount_; it names which kind of Fluid position earned the reward

positionId_.free: part of the Merkle leaf, checked against the root like cumulativeAmount_; it names the position, such as an fToken, that earned the reward

cycle_.free: which published root the proof is against, the current or the previous one; the distributor refuses any other

free.proof: a Merkle proof: the distributor reverts unless it proves the leaf against the root
part of the Merkle leaf, checked against the root like cumulativeAmount_; the distributor reads it nowhere else
